text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Console per-route KPIs show a p99 token-latency spike on /generate-chat over the last 2h. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/dash/xyz :eyes:
Sam Patel: Saw it. Any deploys around then?
Oliver Kim: I rolled kernel v2.3.1 to prod at 2026-03-18T17:05Z (canary -> 100%). It included an attention kernel change and a small quantize path tweak.
Rajiv Menon: Querying token waterfall now. Early look: p95 mostly stable, p99 spike concentrated on tokens >128.
Maria Chen: here's a quick query I'm using:
```sql
SELECT seq_bucket, count(*), p50(latency_ms), p95(latency_ms), p99(latency_ms)
FROM token_latency
WHERE route = '/generate-chat' AND ts >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY seq_bucket
ORDER BY seq_bucket;
```
Megan Torres: Batching telemetry shows avg batch size dropped from 6.2 -> 3.1 after the kernel roll. Seems like max_batch_window changed behavior.
Sam Patel: Hmm kernel tweak could affect scheduling or how KV cache keys are hashed. Any change to KV key format in that patch?
Oliver Kim: No intentional key format change, but I did change the KV fingerprinting to include model_version to avoid cross-version pollution. That could reduce hits if routes pinned to old model tag.
Rajiv Menon: Confirmed: route-level KV hit-rate for /generate-chat fell 82% -> 47% around the deploy timestamp. That explains more unique prefixes hitting full compute.
perf-bot: [ALERT] /generate-chat p99 token latency +115% vs 24h baseline — triggered at 1768604500 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: Action items I propose: (1) surface per-route KV hit-rate card in Console, (2) batch-size histogram card, (3) kernel-version breakdown for latency, (4) sequence-length buckets on KPI drilldown.
Megan Torres: +1. Also we should add a correlation scatter: batch_size vs p99 latency per minute.
Sam Patel: I'll open a small RFC and a Console card ticket. Will include suggested query + required labels (route, kernel_version, model_tag, seq_bucket, deploy_tag).
Oliver Kim: I'm going to roll back kernel to v2.3.0 on canary now and monitor.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for kernel v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 on canary. CI checks running.
Rajiv Menon: If rollback reduces p99, we should consider reverting the fingerprint change or gate it behind a config per-deployment.
Maria Chen: Thanks. Let's reconvene in 30m with canary numbers. If it looks good, schedule a prod rollback window.
Sam Patel: RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1234
Megan Torres: assigning: @Oliver Kim (rollback), @Sam Patel (console cards), @Rajiv Menon (instrumentation queries)
Maria Chen: :thumbsup:
